description:
Better Plans helps turn complicated decisions into clear, practical plans so you can move forward with confidence.

Start with a decision you’re facing or something you want to make happen. Whether you’re planning a wedding or trip, renovating a home, buying a car, making a career move, or tackling another complicated project, Better Plans helps you clarify what matters, understand the tradeoffs, work within real-world constraints, anticipate problems, and turn your thinking into practical next steps.

It combines structured thinking from engineering, risk management, and project planning with AI-guided conversation to help you make stronger decisions without replacing your judgment.

The goal isn’t a perfect plan. It’s to help you choose on purpose, make the call with confidence, adapt when things change, and move forward with intention.
